name: agent-manager-harness-autodev-guard
description: Strict AutoDev gates before Harness tasks are marked complete.

passCriteria: dedicated namespace and service name are recorded
baseUrl is known before API or browser tests
secret refs are recorded by reference only
missing kubeconfig, registry, database, or E2B inputs trigger harness ask
gates.onFail: Keep task in_progress, write awaiting_human output, and use harness ask for the missing environment inputs.

passCriteria: allowlist is present before coding
changed files are inside writeScope
unrelated dirty files are ignored or blocked, never reverted
gates.onFail: harness milestone blocker <task_id> "Scope guard failed: unrelated or out-of-scope diff exists." --require-ack

passCriteria: exitCode is 0
testsPassed equals totalTests
no failed tests are hidden by wrapper commands
gates.onFail: Keep task in_progress and report testsPassed, totalTests, and failing command.

passCriteria: current branch/build artifact is deployed
namespace, service, image tag, rollout status, and /api/health readback are present
local dev server is not used as a substitute for the isolated service
gates.onFail: Keep task in_progress and ask for the missing build/push/deploy input or fix the rollout failure.

passCriteria: tests target the isolated environment baseUrl
request/response or machine-readable test report is attached
exitCode is 0 and testsPassed equals totalTests
gates.onFail: Do not mark API tests complete until the isolated-environment API evidence exists.

passCriteria: tests target the isolated environment baseUrl
evidence is new
evidence directly covers the requested feature
screenshot, video, trace, or log path is included in task output
gates.onFail: Use harness ask or blocker; do not mark generic UI screenshots as done.

passCriteria: git status is reviewed
diff is limited to intended files
review findings are resolved or explicitly accepted by human acknowledgement
gates.onFail: Do not create or update MR until the guard passes.

passCriteria: work item and milestone are present
platform acceptance command is known
required evidence is uploaded or linked
gates.onFail: Stop at evidence boundary; never claim platform completion from local tests alone.

forbiddenClaims: platform accepted without work item evidence
live OOS/K8s verified without readback evidence
API tests complete while targeting only mocks or localhost
unit complete when testsPassed is less than totalTests
question asked while continuing blocked downstream work
